text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono hosts a "Chanko Nabe 
Tournament" to interact with fans. On the 
day of the event, a wide variety of chanko 
nabe proudly prepared by each household is 
on display!

"They were all different, but every single 
one looks delicious!" And so, the chanko 
nabe contest came to an end in a 
heartwarming atmosphere.

A few days later—"I'll protect my flavor, 
and you all protect yours, okay~☆"

Words reflecting Hishi Akebono's way of 
life were posted on Umastagram.

—Awaiting her after summer training camp 
is the Sprinters Stakes. To challenge it 
at full power, days of further rigorous 
training began!
